headword: {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}

definitions.explanation: A company of Japanese origin or with Japanese capital. Used especially of Japanese companies operating abroad, and in Japan's job market in contrast to {外資系|がいしけい} (foreign-affiliated) companies.

examples.japanese: {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work at a Japanese company.

examples.japanese: ⟦タイ→タイ：31002_tai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Many Japanese companies have expanded into Thailand.

examples.japanese: ⟦{現地|げんち}→現地：13502_genchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Local Japanese companies are looking for personnel who can speak Japanese.

notes:
USAGE:
Used of Japanese businesses seen from abroad, and in Japan's job market as the counterpart of ⟦{外資系|がいしけい}→外資系：12219_gaishikei⟧ (⟦{日系|にっけい}→日系：12956_nikkei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{外資系|がいしけい}→外資系：12219_gaishikei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{違|ちが}い→違い：03432_chigai⟧: the difference between Japanese and foreign-affiliated firms). Common in business news, job listings, and discussions of international commerce.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to get a job at a Japanese company abroad)
- {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧ (expansion of Japanese companies overseas)
- {日系企業|にっけいきぎょう}{向|む}け (aimed at Japanese companies)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外資系|がいしけい}→外資系：12219_gaishikei⟧: foreign-affiliated — the reverse perspective, a foreign company operating in Japan
